record.summary: Interim final export-control rule. It set a worldwide licence requirement for advanced AI chips (advanced computing integrated circuits), with licence exceptions for destinations that raise no national security concerns, default country allocations for most other destinations, and Data Center Validated End-User authorisations for entities that adopt security measures. It added a new control (ECCN 4E091) on the weights of closed-weight AI models trained with 10^26 or more operations, reviewed under a presumption of denial except for listed destinations; open-weight models are excluded.
record.notes: Published in the Federal Register on 15 Jan 2025 as an interim final rule with a request for comments, effective 13 Jan 2025. Exporters did not have to comply until 15 May 2025, and some requirements had a delayed compliance date of 15 Jan 2026. The new model-weight control is ECCN 4E091. On 13 May 2025 the Department of Commerce announced its rescission: BIS enforcement officials were instructed not to enforce it, and BIS said it would publish a regulation formalizing the rescission and issue a replacement rule. The same announcement issued guidance on the risks of using PRC advanced computing chips, including Huawei Ascend chips, and on protecting supply chains against diversion.

verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: federalregister.gov answers the archiver only with a bot-check page (stored 11 and 17 Oct 2026, including the browser copies). In this run the Federal Register printing of the rule (FR Doc. 2025-00636, 90 FR 4544) was stored from govinfo.gov (Government Publishing Office), and official_url now points at it. It confirms the title, BIS as issuer, publication on 15 Jan 2025, the 13 Jan 2025 effective date, the 15 May 2025 compliance date, RIN 0694-AJ90 and the controls in the summary. The BIS press release of 13 May 2025 (bis.gov, stored 17 Oct 2026) confirms the rescission announcement, the instruction not to enforce and the plan for a formal rescission regulation and a replacement rule. No stored source shows whether that formal rescission regulation has been published. The press release page was edited between 11 and 17 Oct 2026 ('SI' in place of 'AI' in places, one added bullet on Malaysia and Thailand); the passages quoted are the same in both copies.

changes.official_url: the Federal Register printing of the rule on govinfo.gov, stored in this run; federalregister.gov serves the archiver only a bot-check page, so the record had no stored text of the rule (as done for US-04)
changes.official_identifier: 'ECCN 4E091' removed: it is a control list entry the rule creates, not the rule's citable number; it is now in notes
changes.summary: rewritten from the rule's text: the worldwide licence requirement with exceptions, allocations and VEU authorisations; the model-weight control applies to models trained with 10^26 'or more' operations (not 'more than'), under a presumption of denial except for the destinations in supplement no. 5 to part 740, and excludes open-weight models
changes.notes: rewritten: the remark that the formal rescission could not be confirmed is research-process language and moved to verification.note; adds the delayed compliance date and what BIS announced with the rescission

judgment.status_reasoning: Effective 13 Jan 2025 ('This rule is effective January 13. 2025.'), compliance due 15 May 2025. On 13 May 2025, two days before compliance was due, the Department of Commerce announced a rescission of the rule and BIS enforcement officials were instructed not to enforce it; BIS said it would publish a regulation formalizing the rescission. The rule is no longer applied, so 'Revoked / withdrawn' stands, with date_last_updated 2025-05-13. Whether the formalizing regulation was published is open.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Export-control rule whose model-weight control for closed-weight frontier models (10^26 or more training operations) is an AI-specific security measure; in scope with no note, as published.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published is the Federal Register date, 15 Jan 2025 (the press release also says the rule 'was issued on January 15, 2025'); date_in_force is the stated effective date, 13 Jan 2025, which precedes publication; date_last_updated is the rescission announcement of 13 May 2025.

extra_urls.why: The Federal Register printing of FR Doc. 2025-00636 (15 Jan 2025) on GovInfo, built on the GovInfo Federal Register path (FR-<date>/pdf/<document number>.pdf) used by stored sources of US-04, US-16 and US-29, from the document number and date in the record's official_url. federalregister.gov serves the archiver only a bot-check page, so this is the only way to store the rule's text: title, effective date, 90 FR 4544, RIN, ECCN 4E091 and the 10^26 model-weight control.

open_questions: Formal rescission: the BIS press release of 13 May 2025 says BIS 'plans to publish a regulation formalizing the rescission'. No stored source shows whether that regulation was published; if it was, its date would replace 2025-05-13 in date_last_updated and it would be the better evidence for the status.
